name: Adamantine Thumbnotch
description: The user holds the court's high posture with the hatchet cocked beside the ear so a throw can leave from any guard.

name: Pitiless Chuck
description: The hatchet leaves the belt in a straight upward pull and is hurled at the throat line.

name: Overbearing Tailknob
description: One beard hooks a raised arm aside while the other axe rests ready at the hip.

name: Might Hurl
description: Quick short steps weave in a hawk's wheeling pattern around a slower opponent.

name: Pitiless Lightbit
description: Two hatchets leave the hands on one breath and land a hand's breadth apart at head height.

name: Fastening Balancepoint
description: A hooked beard sweeps the opponent's leading leg across the other so they fall.

name: Chimeflint
description: The user marks the target's path two paces ahead and throws at where they will stand.

name: Downpour Pitch
description: Two lines of thrown hatchets press a group backward from two directions at once.

name: Doctrine Toss
description: A thrown hatchet is followed by a rush that reclaims it from the target as a second blow lands.

name: Torrential Nova Fling
description: A flash step carries the user the whole distance in a blink, the hatchet landing as they arrive.

name: Unbudging Birchhelve
description: The user stands low and wide as water settles in a basin, the axes hanging ready.

name: Wrathful Throwhelve
description: A chop is followed at once by a second cut along the same groove, like a returning echo.

name: Equipoise Spikepoll
description: The haft rolls along the forearm like a river stone and carries a blow off the elbow.

name: Novapitch
description: One axe is thrown while its twin is held ready for wherever the opponent dodges.

name: Tomahead Glare
description: A slip of the feet in the court's measured pace carries the user past a lunging sword.

name: Chime Lob
description: The thrower gathers qi in the stance and releases axe and qi together in a single heave.

name: Headvalor
description: A blade caught between two hafts rings off and rebounds into the opponent's own guard.

name: Might Throwhelve
description: Fast alternate chops run down the opponent's guarding arm like water down a bank.

name: Gyvehurl
description: A thrown axe pins a sleeve to a post while its twin keeps the other hand busy.

name: Lot Tailknob
description: A second axe is thrown to land in the same spot a heartbeat after the first.

name: Berserk Balancepoint
description: Axes thrown from a rim drop into the centre of a hollow and cut off those inside it.

name: Corroding Birchhelve
description: An axe thrown with Xiantian qi crosses the gap in the blink between release and landing, leaving no flight to track.

name: Thorn Quickbit
description: Two hatchets are held at the hips with thumbs on the polls, ready for a double release.

name: Torrent Edgecurve
description: Both axes lift together like spread wings and turn a high cut aside.

name: Iron Spikepoll
description: A short diving step brings both bits down onto the opponent's shoulder in one stroke.

name: Rumble Fling
description: Two axes released together from different heights make the opponent choose which to dodge.

name: Ghosting Pitch
description: A wheeling step circles the guard as a hawk circles prey, and the cut comes from behind.

name: Gyve Thumbnotch
description: The beards lock on a weapon's guard from two sides and pin it still.

name: Intent Toss
description: Two axes plunge from high and low in one sequence that overwhelms a single guard.

name: Silthead
description: Axes thrown in pairs fall on one position from above and force everyone inside to scatter.

name: Flingwrath
description: A single axe thrown with perfect fixing pierces the guard at the one point it must open.

name: Lobruin
description: The user's bow of greeting becomes a draw, the hatchet leaving the belt as the head rises.

name: Thornhead
description: The beard of one axe covers the other hand's hatchet and the arm behind it.

name: Chuckvalor
description: The beard pulls the opponent's shoulder open and the second hatchet comes in from below.

name: Lob Rocketry
description: Low narrow steps keep the user's feet within the court's measured line.

name: Grievous Chuck
description: A throw straight down the centre line lands between the opponent's guarding hands.

name: Gnashing Quickbit
description: The hook is released as the second hatchet descends, pull and cut made as one motion.

name: Overbearing Lightbit
description: Hook and haft trap an arm between them and bend it against the joint.

name: Edgecurve Nerve
description: A thrown hatchet is turned with the flat of the user's own axe and sent past the ear.

name: Lottoss
description: The hook pulls the opponent forward into an axe thrown to meet them.

name: Tossscourge
description: Axes thrown low and hard at the feet of a close group throw their footing off balance.

name: Corroding Tomahead
description: One decisive cut ends the exchange, the bit entering where the guard has been pulled open.

name: Blaze Hurl
description: Both axes are drawn crossing the body and cut outward into the guard on opposite lines.

name: Thornflint
description: One axe leads and one trails on a single line, the two tracks of the school held at once.

name: Blaze Quickbit
description: A pivot on the planted foot sends the axe in an arc around a raised shield.

name: Equipoise Lightbit
description: The trailing axe's haft slaps a thrust off its line while the leading axe cuts.

name: Silt Edgecurve
description: Quick steps along a straight line keep both axes facing the opponent.

name: Gust Birchhelve
description: Two cuts from opposite sides cross at the opponent's guard and break it.

name: Nova Throwhelve
description: One axe flies at the face and one at the knee, so any dodge meets a blade.

name: Waning Tailknob
description: A thrown axe is caught on the haft and returned along a flatter line.

name: Enthralling Spikepoll
description: A beard hooked into the opponent's belt drags them into the second axe's path.

name: Confluent Balancepoint
description: Cut, throw and recovery run on two tracks, each axe striking as the other is parried.

name: Flintruin
description: A wide front of thrown axes falls over a field and drives a group back.

name: Birchblink
description: The user switches between two attack lines mid-rush, forcing the guard to chase and open.

name: Mayhem Lob
description: Both axes loose a tempest of cuts and throws that clears a space around the user, each blow on its own track.

name: Flintlike Birchhelve
description: Qi flows evenly through the whole meridian network into the grip, holding the stance as a river holds its banks.

name: Might Fling
description: A chop gathers qi from the whole network and lands it in one heavy pulse.

name: Flinghavoc
description: Qi from both arms joins at release so the hatchet flies with a doubled drive.

name: Murkbirch
description: Qi spread along both hafts in a net catches a heavy blow and spreads its force.

name: Chime Tomahead
description: The beard hooks a weapon arm and qi in the haft jerks it hard against the opponent's balance.

name: Lightning Pitch
description: Qi gathered in the legs from the network gives bounding steps that follow the ground's slope.

name: Daybreak Quickbit
description: Hatchets thrown on network-driven qi cover a wide arc and press back a rank of soldiers.

name: Hour Thumbnotch
description: Two axes pursue one quarry by different lines, the second arriving as the first is parried.

name: Headruin
description: With the whole meridian network behind it, one chop breaks a guarding weapon and enters the body behind it.

name: Aegis Thumbnotch
description: The user stands side-on to the wind with the axe drawn low, sworn to hold the ground ahead.

name: Hurlhavoc
description: A chop falling with the wind at the user's back splits the guard open.

name: Chime Tailknob
description: The user fixes a bearing and lobs the axe along it without glancing down at the hand.

name: Granite Pitch
description: A step taken on the oath's count keeps the user a fixed distance from the opponent.

name: Evergreen Throwhelve
description: The user turns with the gust as a cut arrives and lets the haft take it at a slant.

name: Rumble Spikepoll
description: A flat long throw runs along a plateau rim to catch an opponent between the user and the drop.

name: Fling Durance
description: The beard hooks a cloak billowing in the wind and the user pulls it across the opponent's eyes.

name: Torrential Balancepoint
description: A sprint across open ground in a straight line trades cover for speed.

name: Granite Hurl
description: Axes released on the gust form a broad sweep over an open slope and hold the line.

name: Lotchuck
description: A sworn bearing joins throw, dash and chop so each follows the last without a break.

name: Hour Hurl
description: The user rides the gale in a blink across open ground and lands the chop before the sound of the step.

name: Granite Tomahead
description: Feet planted wide, the user swears to hold the open ground and presents only the haft to the foe.

name: Sanguine Toss
description: A low chop that follows the lay of the plateau bites into the shin or ankle.

name: Nova Edgecurve
description: A throw against the skyline hides the axe from a squinting opponent.

name: Flintvortex
description: A sideways step checks the user's bearing against a landmark before the next cut.

name: Fastening Lightbit
description: A thrown axe pins a boot or cloak to a post and holds the target where the oath fixed them.

name: Blazetoss
description: A sworn push drives the poll into a guarded chest like a ram.

name: Birchmettle
description: With the wind shifting against a thrown blade, the user turns the haft and lets the gust push it off.

name: Pitchwrath
description: Axes thrown low and flat along a rim keep a column from gaining the ridge.

name: Intent Chuck
description: The user rushes along the sworn bearing to reclaim a thrown axe, its second blow landing on arrival.

name: Merciless Iron Chuck
description: Having sworn the ground, the user makes one unhurried chop that nothing in the guard can turn.

name: Flintlike Tomahead
description: The user squares to the target and takes a bearing, holding the line with loose hands.

name: Brutalizing Toss
description: A chop made as the gust pulls the user forward adds speed to the falling bit.

name: Glint Birchhelve
description: The axe flies a straight line along the held bearing and lands where the eye was fixed.

name: Flintinsight
description: A glance at a pennant or sleeve shows the wind's strength before the throw.

name: Flingblink
description: A side-slip moving with the wind takes the user out of a straight thrust.

name: Rumblehurl
description: A throw released as the gust lifts rides a long arc to land far downwind.

name: Remnant Fling
description: A feint thrown with the sun and wind behind it leaves the opponent guessing which hand will release.

name: Thorn Balancepoint
description: Feet and haft hold the user's bearing against a heavy blow without a step back.

name: Immobilizing Chuck
description: The beard hooks an arm and the user turns with the wind, twisting the arm out of line.

name: Blazehead
description: Axes thrown in succession on the gust fall in a cascade across a wide stretch of ground.

name: Lot Thumbnotch
description: Throw, run and cut keep to one bearing, each blow landing on the line the last opened.

name: Rampaging Tempered Toss
description: A thrown hatchet leaves unseen in the roar of a gust and strikes before the foe can hear it.

name: Obdurate Throwhelve
description: The user stands in the open with the axe low, asking no cover of the ground.

name: Gust Edgecurve
description: A low chop on bare ground cuts behind the knee where nothing shelters the leg.

name: Rumble Lob
description: A throw under open sky carries the axe clean to the target with nothing to deflect it.

name: Blinding Pitch
description: A crouched advance across low grass keeps the user under the opponent's eyeline until the throw.

name: Gust Spikepoll
description: A hard throw into a headwind is held low and flat so the gust cannot turn it.

name: Immobilizing Lightbit
description: A knock of the haft on the weapon hand from the windward side makes the grip slip.

name: Dismantling Spikepoll
description: Axes thrown from open ground rain across the field and give a group no safe place to stand.

name: Quickbit Havoc
description: A stalk, a throw and a closing chop chain across open ground like a hunt on the plateau.

name: Lob Scourge
description: A great throw under open sky sends the hatchet through the guard before any cover can be sought.

name: Charter Tailknob
description: Axes ride at belt, back and thigh so every sweep of the hand finds one.

name: Lightbit Havoc
description: A throw that follows the line of bending grass lands true across a windy field.

name: Waning Tomahead
description: The user counts breaths between gusts and throws in the lull.

name: Iron Tailknob
description: A chop driven from the hip rides the gust into the opponent's guard.

name: Might Chuck
description: A step that puts the wind at the user's back changes the opponent's line of sight.

name: Chimepitch
description: Three axes ride a gust one after another and land on separate parts of one target.

name: Mastering Lob
description: The beard hooks a leading arm and the user's pull follows the wind to drag it wide.

name: Torrent Quickbit
description: Braced against the gust, the haft takes a cut at a slant and sheds its force.

name: Charter Edgecurve
description: Sworn to give no ground, the user covers every side in turn with the axes against several foes.

name: Devastating Fling
description: A gale of axes thrown over a slope falls on the ranks climbing it.

name: Escalating Pitch
description: The user holds a gust at the back through throw, rush and chop, pressing the foe the whole way.

name: Mayhemflint
description: A volley aimed left is bent right by the gust, so a dodge into the apparent gap meets the axes.

name: Titanic Balancepoint
description: Every axe in the carry is loosed at once and covers the ground like a squall.

name: Throwhelve Obduracy
description: Qi circulates through the whole network as wind through open ground and the grip stays loose and strong.

name: Chuckhavoc
description: A downward chop carries qi gathered from the whole network into the bit.

name: Novahead
description: Qi from every channel of the arm is fed into the release so the axe flies hard and flat.

name: Meteoric Thumbnotch
description: Qi through the legs gives a gust-like step that closes the gap at once.

name: Evergreen Quickbit
description: Qi spread through the haft turns a heavy blow aside like wind round a standing stone.

name: Lightbit Spine
description: The beard hooks a limb and a sworn pulse of qi holds it fixed.

name: Facet Toss
description: A throw released on a deep qi pulse covers the plateau's width and lands bit-first.

name: Balancepoint Reckoning
description: Axes loosed on qi drawn from every channel scatter over open ground and halt a line.

name: Hourfling
description: Throw, step and cut are linked by one flow of qi so no gap opens between them.

name: Iron Edgecurve
description: With the network's qi behind it and an oath sworn, one cut parts a guard and the body behind it.
